related_work:
On the Thursday lesson, the class participated in a guest lecture which involved discussions on technology, sustainability and the issues involved with creating and trashing technology at the rate humans currently do. The attendees were then given half an hour to perform an artistic task, capture a device that is important to you using analogue or digital methods, I captured a photo of a Wii U which I then used for a sketch.
After that, the class was introduced to Git and GitHub and was instructed to set up their blog website by following a step-by-step instructional guide on Blackboard. I knew how to use Git and GitHub from my prior experience in Game Design so I was able to follow an earlier version of the guide on Tuesday that used GitLab instead of GitHub. It took a few tries to get the new template uploaded on GitHub but I was able to figure out how to set it up myself using GitHub and GitHub Pages.
conclusion_future_work: The next steps are to start creating sketches of the device that I want to use for the exploration, then using those sketches as the base for pixel art pieces in Aseprite.
title: Week 1
introduction: This week was my introduction to Creative Tech 1: Coding. Boyd started off the first lesson on Tuesday by going over the introduction week's presentation, introducing the course and then going over the current module, Creative Technologies 1: Coding. Boyd in this lesson hosted some physical games to get the class to know each other a little bit more. After that was one we were put in pairs and instructed to interview each other and then create a mood board based on the answers each partner had provided.
